videoUrl.title: Video URL
videoUrl.description: Public HTTPS URL to the rendered MP4. Must be directly downloadable (no auth redirect). Recommended: Apify KV store public URL, GitHub Release asset public URL, or S3 pre-signed URL. Do NOT pass base64 data here.

timelineJson.title: Timeline JSON (events array)
timelineJson.description: The full timeline.json object from the animation project. If omitted, the actor evaluates the video without event-specific context — lower accuracy.

anthropicApiKey.title: Anthropic API Key
anthropicApiKey.description: Anthropic API key for Claude vision calls. Required if modelProvider is 'anthropic'. Keep this secret.

modelName.title: Model Name
modelName.description: Vision-capable LLM to use for evaluation. claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 is recommended for speed and cost; claude-sonnet-5 for higher accuracy.

expectedSchemaVersion.title: Expected Output Schema Version
expectedSchemaVersion.description: The pipeline uses this to guard against actor version drift. Must match the actor's output schemaVersion field.

keyframeIntervalSec.title: Keyframe interval (seconds)
keyframeIntervalSec.description: Extract one keyframe every N seconds as a baseline scan. Freeze events always get additional frames regardless of this setting.

maxKeyframes.title: Max keyframes
maxKeyframes.description: Hard cap on total keyframes extracted. Keeps API cost bounded. 80 is sufficient for a 2.5-minute video at 2s intervals.

frameWidth.title: Keyframe width (pixels)
frameWidth.description: Width to resize each extracted keyframe before sending to the LLM. 640px is enough for motion/pose evaluation and keeps token usage low.

batchSize.title: Frames per LLM batch
batchSize.description: Number of keyframes sent to the LLM in one API call. Lower = more focused analysis per call, higher = fewer API calls.
